events.verdict: Duren (DET) briefly grasps and releases Sarr's (WAS) jersey.
Beasley (DET) leans toward George (WAS) as he sets the pick but the ensuing contact is marginal.
George (WAS) initiates contact with Cunningham's (DET) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Middleton (WAS) places his arms against Duren (DET) and does not affect his put-back shot attempt.
Duren (DET) makes contact with the ball after it exits the imaginary cylinder above the rim.
Poole (WAS) engages with Schroder (DET) on the perimeter and as he disengages, Schroder loses his balance on his own accord.
Schroder's (DET) arm is slightly extended as he sets the screen but the contact with Carrington (WAS) is marginal.
Sarr (WAS) collapses his arm against Cunningham (DET) as they come together in the air before cleanly blocking the shot attempt.
Replay review of the out of bounds called on Sarr (WAS) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Cunningham (DET) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Middleton (WAS) and Harris (DET) briefly engage and disengage on the perimeter.
Sarr (WAS) places his hands against Schroder (DET) and releases away from the pick.
Schroder (DET) swipes down and makes clean contact with the ball during the end of George's (WAS) drive to the basket.
Beasley (DET) legally contests Carrington's (WAS) jump shot attempt.
Middleton (WAS) makes clean contact with the ball to deflect it away from Cunningham (DET).
Beasley (DET) commits a take foul on Middleton (WAS).
Cunningham (DET) commits a take foul on Carrington (WAS).
Harris (DET) firms up in a position in George's (WAS) path and the ensuing contact is marginal as George immediately switches.
Duren (DET) commits a take foul on Smart (WAS).
